title: DVB-S2 Symbol Demodulator
text: Demodulate complex constellation symbol to set of LLR values or data bits according to DVB-S2 standard, 6 inputs, 4 outputs, {Code rate} sets Code rate; {Modulation source} sets the source for modulation type, {Modulation}, {Decision type} sets the type of demapping Approximate log-likelihood, {Output type} sets the type of output, {Unit average power} and {Enable noise variance input port} enables noise variance port. Values come from the instance.
